description:
Calculate the reduced power output of a heating element rated for 5000 W at 240 V when it is operated at 208 V. Use the Electrical Engineering Calculations app (Ohm's Law section) to:
1. First, determine the fixed resistance of the element using the rated values (5000 W, 240 V).
2. Second, use that resistance value and the new voltage (208 V) to calculate the actual power output.
3. Save the final power value (in Watts) to a text file at '/sdcard/Download/derated_power.txt'.
